title: Guest sync loses entries and clears localStorage on partial failure
body: syncGuestDataToAccount iterates entries with an await in a for-loop, catches each failure with console.warn, then calls clear() unconditionally outside the loop. Any per-entry failure = permanent data loss with only a warning toast. No retry, no outbox, no partial-state preservation. Also N sequential mutations: 9 entries = 9 round trips.

title: Duplicate entries when guest sync runs on a second device
body: logExercise generates server-side ids with no idempotency key. Signing in on a second device replays that device's guest cache, producing duplicates the user cannot delete (see #388).

title: requestProfilePhotoUpload rejects HEIC/HEIF content types
body: Presigned upload handler allowlists image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp. iOS camera default is image/heic, so native photo picks fail with a generic error. No client-side transcode and no user-facing explanation.

title: Exercise history issues one query per day (N+1) — 7 round trips per week view
body: Query.exerciseEntries takes a single required AWSDate. ExerciseHistoryPage fans out one query per day in the range; a 30-day view would be 30 queries. Needs a date-range query (sk between EXERCISE#<start> and EXERCISE#<end>) — the single-table design already supports it.

title: Premium features declared in featureGates have no implementation
body: access.ts gates 'analytics', 'data-export', 'custom-activities', 'community', 'exercise-history-full' as premium. None have a route, page or service. SubscriptionPage advertises all of them plus 'Multiple goal types'. Users on trial report this as a broken promise (see ZD-11061).

title: Upgrade to Premium is a placeholder toast — no billing integration
body: handleUpgrade() presents 'Premium subscriptions will be available soon.' No payment provider, no entitlement write-back, and tier is read from a Cognito claim nothing sets.

title: Dark mode token contrast below WCAG AA on primary figures
body: Measured 2.6:1 for --app-color-primary text on --app-color-surface in dark mode; 2.9:1 for muted text. AA requires 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text). Affects the weekly minutes figure, the largest number in the product.

title: WeeklySummary progress ring has no accessible role or value semantics
body: Progress ring is a decorative div stack: no role=progressbar, no aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax, no text alternative. VoiceOver announces an empty group. Also affects StatGrid.

title: Discover articles are a hardcoded MOCK_ARTICLES array
body: articleService serves six articles baked into the bundle, newest publishedAt 2026-07-01. No CMS, so content cannot be updated without a redeploy. Return-visit rate on the tab is collapsing.

title: No offline support: every read is network-only, mutations fail hard
body: apolloClient uses fetchPolicy network-only for exercise history and health profile; no persisted cache, no service worker, no mutation queue. On a flaky connection the compose form loses its contents.

title: Query.profile is readable with the AppSync API key
body: profile(userId) is annotated @aws_api_key for 'public, non-sensitive' reads, but Profile includes dob, location and bio. The API key ships in the client bundle via config.json, so userId enumeration exposes PII for every account. See PEN-2026-03 finding F-02.

title: logExercise accepts durationMinutes up to 99,999 server-side with no sanity bound
body: Client zod schema bounds duration 1..1440 but the resolver performs no validation, so a direct API call can write arbitrary Int. Weekly totals then render as overflowing text.

title: Weight is a scalar on HealthProfile — no history, so no trend possible
body: HealthProfile.weightKg is overwritten on each save. Any weight-trend feature needs a WEIGHT#<date> sort key and a range query. Blocks the most requested premium analytic.

title: Unhandled promise rejection surfaces raw GraphQL error text to users
body: Store actions rethrow Apollo errors; several pages render error.message directly, so users see strings like 'Variable "$input" got invalid value'. Needs an error-mapping layer like lib/auth/utils/errorMessages.ts already provides for auth.

title: Tier claim is read but never written — every paying user resolves to 'free'
body: useAccessTier reads user.tier from the JWT and defaults unknown values to 'free'. Nothing in the Cognito setup adds a tier claim (no pre-token-generation trigger, no group mapping), so premium is unreachable even for a manually flagged account.

title: vue-tsc/eslint toolchain drift blocks CI on Node 22 runners
body: eslint 8 is EOL, vite 5 is two majors behind, cypress 13 predates the Node 22 default runner image. Node 20 hits end of maintenance 2026-04-30 which the deploy Lambda runtimes also depend on.

title: No CloudWatch alarms or dashboards on AppSync resolver errors
body: Observability dashboards were descoped at consolidation. Every incident this quarter was discovered from support tickets rather than telemetry. MTTD averaged 4.6 days.

title: Exercise entry deletion requested by GDPR flow has no code path
body: DPA commitments require erasure within 30 days. There is no delete mutation for health items, no account deletion endpoint and no documented manual runbook. Currently actioned by an engineer running ad-hoc DynamoDB deletes.

title: Unmet capability requests emit no analytics event
body: We only know users want a plan and a monthly report from tickets and help-centre logs. No surface emits an event when a user asks for a capability we do not have, so demand had to be reconstructed from the help-centre search log.

title: HealthProfile stores only heightCm/weightKg — no unit preference anywhere
body: schema.graphql HealthProfile exposes heightCm and weightKg and SaveHealthProfileInput accepts the same. There is no unitSystem field on the profile and no conversion in the UI, so imperial-locale users type imperial numbers into metric fields and we persist them unconverted. Storage should stay metric; display and entry need a per-user preference.

title: No plan entity: nothing in the schema can represent a scheduled future session
body: Every type in the health domain is retrospective: ExerciseEntry has a date in the past and a duration that already happened. There is no way to express 'planned' versus 'completed', so plan adherence is unmeasurable and a generated plan has nowhere to live. Needs a PLAN# sort-key prefix on the health single table plus plan/planned-session types.

title: exerciseEntries takes a single required AWSDate — no range query for reports
body: Query.exerciseEntries(date: AWSDate!) forces one query per day. A one-week report is 7 round trips and a one-month report is ~30, which the client cannot do inside a reasonable render budget. The sort key is EXERCISE#<date>#<id> so a between() on the sort key gives us the range in one query. This blocks periodic reports and is the same root cause as the history N+1.

title: No aggregation path: report totals would be computed client-side from raw entries
body: Even with a range query, there is no server-side rollup. Totals, per-week buckets and period-over-period deltas would all be recomputed in the browser on every render. A report resolver should aggregate in the resolver and return computed figures; the narrative layer can then be generated over trustworthy numbers.

title: No model invocation path or cost controls in the stack
body: If plan generation and report narration go through a managed model, the stack needs an invocation path, per-user rate limiting, a token budget, a cost metric wired to an alarm, and a deterministic fallback so a model outage degrades rather than breaks. None of that exists. ADR-010 makes this a precondition rather than a follow-up.
